lines.2: I was waiting for Konoe in the hallway, but she still hadn't shown up.
lines.3: I had something I wanted to talk to her about when I returned her notebook.
lines.4: I had to suggest a fresh start.
lines.6: I couldn't reach her on my phone either; the signal was too weak.
lines.7: Reception at Ryuumeikan Academy was spotty sometimes.
lines.8: 「Tsushima! Everyone is here, so we go karaoke!」
lines.9: 「Go on ahead. I'll catch up soon.」
lines.10: 「Looks like I'll have to go to Class 2-A myself.」
lines.12: I wasn't exactly eager to visit that class, though.
lines.14: 「Perfect timing. Could you get Konoe for me, Murano?」
lines.15: 「Tch. I thought I'd needle you by getting your name wrong, but that's a pretty good comeback, Tsushima.」
lines.17: 「You honestly got it wrong!? It's Murata!」
lines.19: 「Konoe, huh... She's a nag, but I suppose she's a good fit for a slob like you.」
lines.20: 「...Konoe isn't popular with the guys in Class 2-A?」
lines.21: 「She's certainly good-looking, but that preachy side of hers cancels it right out.」
lines.22: 「Everyone listens when Kurogane-senpai warns them because she has authority. But Konoe's shrill nagging can really grate on you.」
lines.24: Part of me felt a little relieved.
lines.25: 「In any case, she never stops nagging.」
lines.28: 「You tease me, but what about you and Nishizaki?」
lines.30: 「Th-that's just her getting attached to me all on her own.」
lines.32: 「I'm the one being put out here.」
lines.33: 「She's even making me help her on a photography trip to Minami-Boso this summer. Quite a nuisance, wouldn't you say?」
lines.35: 「I know, but she's so prone to getting into trouble.」
lines.36: 「I simply can't leave her on her own.」
lines.38: 「Hm. Was that your way of asking me to introduce you to one of my twelve sisters?」
lines.39: 「I'm not about to score that kind of own goal.」
lines.46: 「...Noriko, you've been getting awfully carried away lately.」
lines.47: A chorus of teasing followed Konoe out into the hallway.
lines.48: 「Uh, sorry. I drew attention to you.」
lines.49: 「I don't really care. So, what is it?」
lines.51: I handed her the notebook, wrapped in a bag.
lines.55: Whoa, inviting her was more embarrassing than I'd expected.
lines.56: But if I didn't take the plunge, nothing would ever start.
lines.57: Come on. I can do this.
lines.58: 「Do you have any... free time over summer vacation?」
lines.60: 「Then let me have a fresh start.」
lines.62: 「We had fun last time, but it felt like the Principal threw everything into chaos, right?」
lines.63: 「So this time... why don't we hang out, just the two of us from the start?」
lines.64: 「R-right! Come to think of it, this was originally supposed to be about you thanking me for the notebook.」
lines.65: 「In that sense, the deserted island was pointless.」
lines.68: 「Oh, fine. If that's what this is about, I suppose I can.」
lines.70: We could work out the details over the phone.
lines.71: Having a proper reason sure made it easier to invite her.
